# Disagreement Log — GTH_091

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 91
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 91 | "you read the face" | "you examine the face" | "you can read the sky and earth like a book" | Sign-reading verb and scope |
| 2 | 91 | "have not recognized" | "have not come to know" | "haven't recognized" | Recognition vs. *gnōsis* as arriving at knowledge |
| 3 | 91 | "this present moment" | "this present time" | "this moment" | *kairos*: moment vs. time |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "read the face" (preserving the sign-reading metaphor), "recognized" (perceptual rather than cognitive), and "this present moment" (*kairos* as decisive instant, not general time).
